const recordAnimationFrames = (callback, autoStart = true) => {
  let running = false, raf;

  const stop = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    run();
  };

  const run = () => {
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      callback();
      if (running) run();
    });
  };

  if (autoStart) start();

  return { start, stop };
};

const recordAnimationFrames = (callback, autoStart = true) => {
  let running = false, raf;

  const stop = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    run();
  };

  const run = () => {
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      callback();
      if (running) run();
    });
  };

  if (autoStart) start();

  return { start, stop };
};

const cb = () => console.log('Animation frame fired');

const recorder = recordAnimationFrames(cb);
// Logs 'Animation frame fired' on each animation frame
recorder.stop();
// Stops logging
recorder.start();
// Starts again

// `start` needs to be explicitly called to begin recording frames
